opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must live in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks of the year and hold or have held a teaching and/or research post at a UK university with research degree or taught degree awarding powers or an Independent Research Organisation or Institute listed as eligible for UKRI funding at the point of retirement; have retired by the time of commencing the Fellowship and no longer have a normal contract of employment (may hold a part-time position of up to 0.5 FTE); and have an established record of research. Applications require institutional approval from the 2026 round onwards.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication. Fellowships are tenable for 3 to 24 months and must commence between 1 August 2027 and 1 July 2028. Application materials will be available on this page during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice or medical applications

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres (Leverhulme Centenary Research Centres)

amount.raw: Up to £10 million available for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible institutions are UK universities defined as an institution registered by the Office for Students and which holds its own research degree awarding powers. A Leverhulme Research Centre may be based at a single university or be a collaboration between multiple institutions. Each UK university may submit one application as principal applicant but may act as a partner in multiple proposals. Previously excluded institutions (Universities of Oxford and Cambridge and Imperial College London) are eligible in this round.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Up to £10 million is available for up to 10 years. The Centenary Research Centre round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.
discipline_tags: All subjects in the Trust's remit

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that will extend beyond the duration of the Fellowship; be experienced researchers, particularly those prevented by routine duties from undertaking or completing a research programme; be resident in the United Kingdom at the time of application; and be a permanent member of the UK scholarly community with an established track record. Fellows must commit a minimum of 75% of their time to the research project.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research. Fellowships are tenable for between 3 and 24 months, up to a maximum value of £70,000. Approximately 100 Fellowships are offered each year. Application materials will be available on this page in September 2026. Fellowships must be taken up between 1 June 2027 and 1 May 2028.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice or medical applications

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards (Centenary Research Leadership Awards)

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: To be eligible at the time of application, applicants must have had at least two years full-time or equivalent experience in a research or teaching post in a university after the date of their PhD award; already hold a permanent academic appointment at a UK university at lecturer level or equivalent, or be nominated by a UK university that undertakes to offer a contract for the duration of the award; and be at an early stage of their academic career. Applicants at Senior Lecturer, Reader/Associate Professor or Professor level are not eligible. Each institution is limited to one bid.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars who are embarking on a university career who need to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028. Awards are for up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs, over 4 to 5 years.
discipline_tags: Any research area except excluded areas (disease/illness studies, clinical research, policy-driven research, advocacy, immediate commercial application, database assembly)

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible institutions are UK universities and other institutions of higher education in the UK, and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations defined as eligible by UKRI. The applicant (Principal Investigator) must take responsibility for directing the grant and their employing institution must agree to administer it. Eligible applicants must already be employed by the eligible institution or be academics who have maintained close links following retirement. Up to three co-applicants may be included.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. The maximum grant value is £500,000 and grants may be held for up to five years. The outline stage of the scheme is paused and will be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026; invited applicants may submit Detailed Applications by 1 September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research, policy-influencing research, immediate commercial application, database assembly, advocacy, capacity building, networking, skills development
